To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the holographic models of large N gauge theory with fundamental flavours that we study, exhibit the following phenomena in the presence of external fields: (i) magnetic catalysis, (ii) Zeeman splitting, (iii) enhancement of meson mass, (iv) enhancement of mesonic stability, (v) a propagating sound-like mode in the presence of magnetic field, (vi) flavour bound state dissociation for sufficiently high electric field and (vii) electric field induced current.

we have studied the dynamics of fundamental flavour degrees of freedom in large N_c strongly coupled gauge theories in a strong external magnetic field and found that the external field induces a dynamical chiral symmetry breaking in the flavour sector and also that the meson spectrum gets modified.
we explicitly demonstrated the "magnetic catalysis" in two holographic models, obtained the analytic dispersion relation in Type IIA model and studied the effects of an electric field.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of external fields in the holographic duals and we have studied the dynamics of fundamental flavors in the presence of external fields.

the effects of external fields on the flavour dynamics and thermodynamics in strongly coupled gauge theories and the holographic models provide a useful tool to study the effects of external magnetic and electric fields in strongly coupled gauge theory.
the study of the effects of external electromagnetic fields on the flavour dynamics in the strongly coupled gauge theories.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the holographic models we study here are consistent with the expectations from the condensed matter physics and the quantum field theory.
external fields can have profound effects on the dynamics of fundamental flavour degrees of freedom.
the external magnetic field has the effect of inducing chiral symmetry breaking in the flavour sector, while the electric field has the effect opposite to that.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have studied the effects of an electromagnetic field in a strongly coupled gauge theory with fundamental flavours and have observed a rich phenomenology.
we demonstrate the magnetic catalysis effect in holographic models and study the associated dynamics of the flavour bound states and their thermodynamics in detail.
the holographic dual models of large N_c gauge theory are very useful for understanding the dynamics of strongly coupled gauge theories in the presence of external fields.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the presence of the external field, the flavour dynamics is qualitatively different from the field-free case.
the dynamics of fundamental flavour fields is significantly altered in the presence of external magnetic and electric fields.
the dynamics of fundamental flavour in the holographic dual is sensitive to the external field and that it is possible to use this sensitivity as a probe of the dual gauge theory.
